results.text: Randomised double blind placebo controlled clinical trial of sucralfate and ranitidine in chronic duodenal ulcer. A double blind, randomised, placebo controlled clinical trial was carried out in endoscopically proved chronic duodenal ulcer patients to compare the efficacy of sucralfate and ranitidine. Sucralfate 1 g four times daily and ranitidine 150 mg twice daily were found to be equally effective in inducing ulcer healing (73.1% and 82.1% respectively) during the 6-week treatment period. results.text: Ranitidine multicenter study on slow-response duodenal ulcer patients.
